datasets: WMT Metrics Shared Task up to 2022
outputs: The paper generates machine translation outputs and evaluates them using reranking methods.

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as it's mentioned only in passing in literature review. Consolidated dataset names to canonical forms. Added encoder models that are explicitly used. Simplified output descriptions.
Removed LogprobAvg/Sum as they are not evaluation metrics but candidate selection statistics. Removed 'Comet' (keep only normalized COMETKiwi). Normalized metric names to standard forms.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. COMETKiwi and other metrics are traditional evaluation models, not LLM-based judges.

guideline: Human raters provided quality judgments using the DA+SQM protocol which involves direct assessment and subjective quality metrics

changes_made.explanation: Human evaluation is referenced but no specific evaluation criteria are detailed beyond the annotation protocol.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on machine translation reranking using Bayesian optimization. It uses traditional automatic metrics (COMETKiwi) and references human evaluation data but doesn't conduct new human evaluations. The extraction was generally good but included some items mentioned only in literature review context.
